# AACL Global — Audits and Assurance Consult Ltd
# https://www.aaclglobal.com/

> AACL Global is a professional consultancy providing ISO management systems, security standards, cybersecurity risk assessment, statutory compliance and continuous compliance (eCompliance) services. Headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya, with delivery onsite or remote worldwide.

## Primary resources

- Homepage: https://www.aaclglobal.com/

## Core services

- Physical & cybersecurity risk and vulnerability assessments
- ISO management systems consultancy (including ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO 45001, ISO 14001, ISO 22000, ISO 22301)
- Security standards implementation and audits (including GSMA SAS, PCI DSS and related schemes where offered)
- Security Manager as a Service (SMaaS)
- Statutory compliance consultancy, audits and training

## Geographic presence

- Headquarters: Vision Towers, Muthangari Drive, Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya
- Delivery: onsite and remote for clients in Africa, Europe, the United Kingdom, the United States, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific
